title: Additional fixtures.
officialText:
Fixtures, other than the circuit-vented fixtures, are permitted to discharge to the horizontal branch
drain. Such fixtures shall be located on the same floor as the circuit-vented fixtures and shall be either individually or common
vented.
SECTION PC 912
COMBINATION DRAIN AND VENT SYSTEM
